positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Osano, a leading data privacy platform, simplifies privacy compliance by helping organizations build, manage, and scale their privacy program to increase trust, stay compliant, and do the right thing. Founded in Austin, Texas, the data privacy management company solves for consent management, data subject rights, assessments, and vendor risk — all in one place.

honors.title: Alfred W. Allen Award
honors.description: The award is presented in recognition of the outstanding GPA you earned during your time in Materials Science and Engineering.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Illinois Urbana Champaign, Grainger College of Engineering · May 2020

honors.title: Arthur L. Friedberg Award
honors.description: This award was established in memory of Arthur L. Friedberg and his contributions to excellence in ceramic engineering education and recognizes superior academic achievement coupled with leadership in student activities.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Illinois Urbana Champaign, Grainger College of Engineering · May 2020
